thesis: Current costs and earnings conversion weigh more heavily than older cash-flow quality for entry. The bull offers future productivity but not evidence that it has arrived.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue growth of 28% and substantial existing cash generation offer a strong base for recovering conversion if spending productivity improves.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive operating-income and EPS growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters where expense growth exceeds revenue growth and operating income declines.
evidence_gaps: Current capex commitments and incremental monetization returns.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Strong sales support demand while expense growth weakens current conversion
Revenue growth demonstrates demand but the 55% cost increase, 8% operating-income decline and 13% EPS decline identify an actual conversion problem
